source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted OpenDBFromFile still constructs nsMailDatabase when aFolder is null, despite its TODO saying this should eventually fail. IMAP RenameClient still calls this path with nullptr. Record the fallback as current behavior and Bug 1947892 as the TODO's cited dependency, with its discussion and status unread; the comment is not evidence that null has already become invalid. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Retain the actual folderless database fallback until its callers change
